hints.title: Initial Health Floor
hints.text: You need at least 1 health point remaining after taking all damage across all levels.

hints.title: Optimal Armor Application
hints.text: The armor can be used at most once on one level, deflecting min(armor, damage[i]) points of damage.

hints.title: Greedy Peak Level Choice
hints.text: To deflect the maximum amount of damage, apply the armor to the level with the highest damage: min(armor, max(damage)).

hints.title: Arithmetic Health Formula

complexity.notes: Single pass finds sum and maximum damage level.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating armor application across every level individually is O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate immediately derives the closed-form 1 + sum - min(armor, max(damage)) result.
